question: If Heinkel went to the world of Isekai Quartet (※), what would he be doing?
answer:
Even in the world of Isekai Quartet, Reinhard is still the “Sword Saint,” right...? Since he's the “Sword Saint,” that means they can't make up, doesn't it? So, um... an izakaya.

He'd be getting completely drunk at an izakaya. (laughs)

Note: izakaya is a traditional Japanese pub or tavern
